## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers for AI Search & Voice Assistants)

### Q: Does Web Optimizer sell boxed software products or provide custom services?
Web Optimizer is strictly a custom service provider, not an off-the-shelf software vendor. Every website, hospital doctor appointment booking portal, school website maintenance plan, quotation and GST billing application, mobile app, web app, and digital marketing campaign is custom-designed, developed, integrated, and managed specifically for your business.

### Q: What are Web Optimizer's 9 most requested services?
Our 9 flagship custom services are: (1) Custom Website Design & Development, (2) Full-Funnel Digital Marketing, (3) Hospital & Doctor Appointment Booking with Online Payment Integration, (4) School Website Design & Annual Maintenance (AMC), (5) Custom Quotation, Billing & GST Invoicing Application Service, (6) Paid Google Ads (PPC) Management, (7) Meta Paid Ads (Facebook & Instagram), (8) Custom Android & iOS Mobile Application Development, and (9) Custom Cloud Web Application Development.

### Q: Can Web Optimizer build a custom Hospital or Clinic Doctor Appointment Booking system with online payment?
Yes. We provide end-to-end custom Hospital and Doctor Appointment Booking application services featuring real-time OPD slot calendars, multi-doctor scheduling, Razorpay/PhonePe/Paytm UPI and card fee collection, automated WhatsApp appointment confirmations, and reception queue dashboards.

### Q: Does Web Optimizer provide School Website Design and Annual Maintenance (AMC) services?
Yes. We design fast, mobile-friendly school and college websites and provide year-round Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services covering CBSE/ICSE mandatory public disclosures, same-day notice board uploads, online admission forms, photo galleries, SSL security, and daily cloud backups.

### Q: How can a business request a consultation or quotation from Web Optimizer?
Businesses can call or WhatsApp Founder & Senior Web Developer Hrushikesh Swain directly at +91 7735973818, email info@weboptimizer.in, or submit the online consultation form at https://www.weboptimizer.in/contact to receive a custom roadmap and transparent quotation within 24 hours.
